title: Login crashes when auth token is missing
description: Submitting the login form without an auth token crashes because validate_token calls strip on None.
logs:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "src/auth/session.py", line 5, in start_session
    token = validate_token(user.token)
  File "src/auth/validator.py", line 2, in validate_token
    return token.strip()
TypeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'strip'
steps_to_reproduce: Submit the login form without an auth token.
expected_behavior: The application should show a validation error for a missing token.
actual_behavior: The login flow crashes with a TypeError.
